# Pinned GPU environment for the yggdrax scaling campaign (C3/C4).
#
# jax 0.11.2 with the CUDA 12 pip wheels (CUDA, cuDNN and NCCL come as
# nvidia-* wheels; only the NVIDIA driver comes from the system, >= 525, a
# CUDA 12.9-era driver >= 575 avoids PTX-JIT fallbacks). jax >= 0.9.1 is
# REQUIRED: older XLA corrupts the native ragged all-to-all once buffers move
# (yggdrax.distributed.comm.RAGGED_NATIVE_FIXED_JAX), and 0.11.2 is the version
# CI type-checks against. Resolved 2026-11-09 for CPython 3.12, manylinux x86_64:
#
#   pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed --platform manylinux_2_28_x86_64 \
#     ... --python-version 3.12 --only-binary=:all: --report lock.json \
#     "jax[cuda12]==0.11.2" jaxtyping beartype numpy pytest <the nvidia-* deps>
#
# Install with build_env.sh (pip install --require-hashes is not used: the
# wheels differ per platform tag).
beartype==0.23.1
iniconfig==2.3.1

jax-cuda12-plugin==0.11.2

ml_dtypes==0.6.0
numpy==2.5.4
nvidia-cublas-cu12==12.9.3.13

nvidia-cuda-cupti-cu12==12.8.90
nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12==12.9.86
